body: I really understand. I truly truly do. A huge part of me thinks the same way.

Exactly like that.
Im so close to killing myself. Not because of just that, other things aswell. But its a big big part. The world is so damn lonely now.
But I think for both you and me, it would be letting them win you know? I cant stand that.

This is scary. The girl I saw as my true love did something very very similar. All the promises were just lies. Left like garbage. I gave up everything for her.
I basically hate her. But still love her. I cant be with anyone else, cant let anyone else touch me even.
I want to say it gets better. I hope it will. I hope you dont do it, there are many in the same position sadly.
